company.shortDescription: Slik is a company that helps sales teams automate email marketing and generating leads.
company.description:
Slik automates lead generation and prospecting for sales teams.

The company allows to access contextual data about decision makers to make cold outreach feel warm. It also has the highest email accuracy on the market, to make sure emails get to real people, not to spam. Slik creates a most targeted lists using an advance filtering system.
